# Phase 15.1: Client-Side Search - Context

**Gathered:** 2026-02-24
**Status:** Ready for planning

## Phase Boundary

Users can search file and folder names across their entire vault with an encrypted index persisted in IndexedDB. The search is triggered via a command palette overlay (Cmd/Ctrl+K). The index updates incrementally when IPNS polling detects metadata changes. Shared items are not indexed. Full-text content search is out of scope.

## Implementation Decisions

### Search Interface

- Command palette / spotlight style overlay triggered by Cmd/Ctrl+K keyboard shortcut
- Small clickable search icon in the header as a visual hint (alongside the shortcut)
- Centered modal with search input at top, results streaming below as user types
- Escape key and click-outside both dismiss the overlay
- Backdrop: #000000CC (dimmed app background)

### Result Presentation

- Each result shows: file/folder name (bold), parent path breadcrumb, last modified date (right-aligned, abbreviated)
- File type icons (lucide) distinguish files from folders (file-text, folder, file-lock, file-spreadsheet, etc.)
- Match characters highlighted in the file name
- Keyboard navigable: arrow keys move selection, Enter opens result
- Selected state: green left border accent (2px #00D084) + subtle background highlight (#001a11)
- Click/select navigates to the parent folder with the matched item highlighted
- Footer shows keyboard hints: "↑↓ navigate ↵ open esc close" and "⌘K search"

### Index Scope & Behavior

- Index covers both file names and folder names (not content)
- Fuzzy matching (like VS Code file search — typing 'rpt' matches 'report.pdf')
- Index updates automatically on every IPNS poll (30s interval) when metadata changes detected
- Index encrypted with user's key before persisting to IndexedDB (zero-knowledge on disk)
- Own vault only — shared items ("Shared with me") are not indexed

### Empty & Edge States

- No results: simple message "No results for 'xyz'" — minimal, no suggestions
- First-time indexing: build on first search open with "Building index..." loading state
- Empty input: placeholder text "Search files..." only, no other content
- Empty vault: same "No results" message (no special empty-vault state needed)

### Claude's Discretion

- Exact number of visible results before scroll (somewhere around 8-10)
- Loading skeleton/spinner design during index build
- Debounce timing for search-as-you-type
- IndexedDB schema for encrypted index storage
- minisearch configuration (fields, boost weights, fuzzy threshold)

## Specific Ideas

- Command palette feel like VS Code Cmd+P or Raycast — fast, keyboard-first
- Terminal aesthetic must be preserved: JetBrains Mono, green on black, sharp corners (0 radius)
- Search overlay width: 600px (spacious option chosen), centered horizontally, positioned ~120px from top
- File type icons from lucide icon set (file-text, folder, file-lock, file-spreadsheet, etc.) in muted green (#006644), turning bright (#00D084) on selected row
- Result count shown as terminal comment: "// 5 results"

## Approved Design Direction

**Frame:** Option B: Spacious (ID: rLDDc)
**Canvas location:** `Drafts - Phase 15.1: Search` (right side of canvas at x:30040)

**Key design decisions:**

- 600px wide palette with 1px #00D084 border
- Search input: 14px font, lucide search icon, "ESC to close" hint
- Results: horizontal layout with icon (16px) + info column (name 12px bold, path 10px muted) + date (10px dim, right-aligned)
- Selected state: #001a11 background, 2px left #00D084 border, icon turns bright green
- Footer: keyboard hints in #4a5a4e, separated by top border #003322

## Deferred Ideas

- Recent search history (show 2-3 past queries on overlay open) — nice-to-have for future release
- Searching shared items — would require indexing across share boundaries, separate phase
- Full-text content search — fundamentally different (requires decrypting file contents), out of scope

**Prior Decisions from STATE.md relevant to this phase:**
- minisearch + idb for client-side search (~8KB total, TypeScript-native, zero server interaction) -- research decision

**Codebase Architecture Context:**

The web app is at `apps/web/` with React + Zustand + React Query. Key integration points:
- `apps/web/src/lib/` — crypto, services, stores
- `apps/web/src/hooks/` — React hooks (useFolder, useAuth, etc.)
- `apps/web/src/components/` — React components
- `packages/crypto/` — shared crypto module (@cipherbox/crypto)
- IPNS polling happens in the folder store (Zustand) via `useInterval`
- Folder metadata is decrypted client-side and stored in Zustand
- AES-256-GCM is used for content encryption
- User's vaultKeypair (secp256k1) is in the auth store
- IndexedDB is already used for device registry (via `idb` library)

# Phase 15.1: Client-Side Search - Context

**Gathered:** 2026-02-24
**Status:** Ready for planning

## Phase Boundary

Users can search file and folder names across their entire vault with an encrypted index persisted in IndexedDB. The search is triggered via a command palette overlay (Cmd/Ctrl+K). The index updates incrementally when IPNS polling detects metadata changes. Shared items are not indexed. Full-text content search is out of scope.

## Implementation Decisions

### Search Interface

- Command palette / spotlight style overlay triggered by Cmd/Ctrl+K keyboard shortcut
- Small clickable search icon in the header as a visual hint (alongside the shortcut)
- Centered modal with search input at top, results streaming below as user types
- Escape key and click-outside both dismiss the overlay
- Backdrop: #000000CC (dimmed app background)

### Result Presentation

- Each result shows: file/folder name (bold), parent path breadcrumb, last modified date (right-aligned, abbreviated)
- File type icons (lucide) distinguish files from folders (file-text, folder, file-lock, file-spreadsheet, etc.)
- Match characters highlighted in the file name
- Keyboard navigable: arrow keys move selection, Enter opens result
- Selected state: green left border accent (2px #00D084) + subtle background highlight (#001a11)
- Click/select navigates to the parent folder with the matched item highlighted
- Footer shows keyboard hints: "↑↓ navigate ↵ open esc close" and "⌘K search"

### Index Scope & Behavior

- Index covers both file names and folder names (not content)
- Fuzzy matching (like VS Code file search — typing 'rpt' matches 'report.pdf')
- Index updates automatically on every IPNS poll (30s interval) when metadata changes detected
- Index encrypted with user's key before persisting to IndexedDB (zero-knowledge on disk)
- Own vault only — shared items ("Shared with me") are not indexed

### Empty & Edge States

- No results: simple message "No results for 'xyz'" — minimal, no suggestions
- First-time indexing: build on first search open with "Building index..." loading state
- Empty input: placeholder text "Search files..." only, no other content
- Empty vault: same "No results" message (no special empty-vault state needed)

### Claude's Discretion

- Exact number of visible results before scroll (somewhere around 8-10)
- Loading skeleton/spinner design during index build
- Debounce timing for search-as-you-type
- IndexedDB schema for encrypted index storage
- minisearch configuration (fields, boost weights, fuzzy threshold)

## Specific Ideas

- Command palette feel like VS Code Cmd+P or Raycast — fast, keyboard-first
- Terminal aesthetic must be preserved: JetBrains Mono, green on black, sharp corners (0 radius)
- Search overlay width: 600px (spacious option chosen), centered horizontally, positioned ~120px from top
- File type icons from lucide icon set (file-text, folder, file-lock, file-spreadsheet, etc.) in muted green (#006644), turning bright (#00D084) on selected row
- Result count shown as terminal comment: "// 5 results"

## Approved Design Direction

**Frame:** Option B: Spacious (ID: rLDDc)
**Canvas location:** `Drafts - Phase 15.1: Search` (right side of canvas at x:30040)

**Key design decisions:**

- 600px wide palette with 1px #00D084 border
- Search input: 14px font, lucide search icon, "ESC to close" hint
- Results: horizontal layout with icon (16px) + info column (name 12px bold, path 10px muted) + date (10px dim, right-aligned)
- Selected state: #001a11 background, 2px left #00D084 border, icon turns bright green
- Footer: keyboard hints in #4a5a4e, separated by top border #003322

## Deferred Ideas

- Recent search history (show 2-3 past queries on overlay open) — nice-to-have for future release
- Searching shared items — would require indexing across share boundaries, separate phase
- Full-text content search — fundamentally different (requires decrypting file contents), out of scope

**Prior Decisions from STATE.md relevant to this phase:**
- minisearch + idb for client-side search (~8KB total, TypeScript-native, zero server interaction) -- research decision

**Codebase Architecture Context:**

The web app is at `apps/web/` with React + Zustand + React Query. Key integration points:
- `apps/web/src/lib/` — crypto, services, stores
- `apps/web/src/hooks/` — React hooks (useFolder, useAuth, etc.)
- `apps/web/src/components/` — React components
- `packages/crypto/` — shared crypto module (@cipherbox/crypto)
- IPNS polling happens in the folder store (Zustand) via `useInterval`
- Folder metadata is decrypted client-side and stored in Zustand
- AES-256-GCM is used for content encryption
- User's vaultKeypair (secp256k1) is in the auth store

# Phase 15.1: Client-Side Search - Context

**Gathered:** 2026-02-24
**Status:** Ready for planning

## Phase Boundary

Users can search file and folder names across their entire vault with an encrypted index persisted in IndexedDB. The search is triggered via a command palette overlay (Cmd/Ctrl+K). The index updates incrementally when IPNS polling detects metadata changes. Shared items are not indexed. Full-text content search is out of scope.

## Implementation Decisions

### Search Interface

- Command palette / spotlight style overlay triggered by Cmd/Ctrl+K keyboard shortcut
- Small clickable search icon in the header as a visual hint (alongside the shortcut)
- Centered modal with search input at top, results streaming below as user types
- Escape key and click-outside both dismiss the overlay
- Backdrop: #000000CC (dimmed app background)

### Result Presentation

- Each result shows: file/folder name (bold), parent path breadcrumb, last modified date (right-aligned, abbreviated)
- File type icons (lucide) distinguish files from folders (file-text, folder, file-lock, file-spreadsheet, etc.)
- Match characters highlighted in the file name
- Keyboard navigable: arrow keys move selection, Enter opens result
- Selected state: green left border accent (2px #00D084) + subtle background highlight (#001a11)
- Click/select navigates to the parent folder with the matched item highlighted
- Footer shows keyboard hints: "↑↓ navigate ↵ open esc close" and "⌘K search"

### Index Scope & Behavior

- Index covers both file names and folder names (not content)
- Fuzzy matching (like VS Code file search — typing 'rpt' matches 'report.pdf')
- Index updates automatically on every IPNS poll (30s interval) when metadata changes detected
- Index encrypted with user's key before persisting to IndexedDB (zero-knowledge on disk)
- Own vault only — shared items ("Shared with me") are not indexed

### Empty & Edge States

- No results: simple message "No results for 'xyz'" — minimal, no suggestions
- First-time indexing: build on first search open with "Building index..." loading state
- Empty input: placeholder text "Search files..." only, no other content
- Empty vault: same "No results" message (no special empty-vault state needed)

### Claude's Discretion

- Exact number of visible results before scroll (somewhere around 8-10)
- Loading skeleton/spinner design during index build
- Debounce timing for search-as-you-type
- IndexedDB schema for encrypted index storage
- minisearch configuration (fields, boost weights, fuzzy threshold)

## Specific Ideas

- Command palette feel like VS Code Cmd+P or Raycast — fast, keyboard-first
- Terminal aesthetic must be preserved: JetBrains Mono, green on black, sharp corners (0 radius)
- Search overlay width: 600px (spacious option chosen), centered horizontally, positioned ~120px from top
- File type icons from lucide icon set (file-text, folder, file-lock, file-spreadsheet, etc.) in muted green (#006644), turning bright (#00D084) on selected row
- Result count shown as terminal comment: "// 5 results"

## Approved Design Direction

**Frame:** Option B: Spacious (ID: rLDDc)
**Canvas location:** `Drafts - Phase 15.1: Search` (right side of canvas at x:30040)

**Key design decisions:**

- 600px wide palette with 1px #00D084 border
- Search input: 14px font, lucide search icon, "ESC to close" hint
- Results: horizontal layout with icon (16px) + info column (name 12px bold, path 10px muted) + date (10px dim, right-aligned)
- Selected state: #001a11 background, 2px left #00D084 border, icon turns bright green
- Footer: keyboard hints in #4a5a4e, separated by top border #003322

## Deferred Ideas

- Recent search history (show 2-3 past queries on overlay open) — nice-to-have for future release
- Searching shared items — would require indexing across share boundaries, separate phase
- Full-text content search — fundamentally different (requires decrypting file contents), out of scope

**Prior Decisions from STATE.md relevant to this phase:**
- minisearch + idb for client-side search (~8KB total, TypeScript-native, zero server interaction) -- research decision

**Codebase Architecture Context:**

The web app is at `apps/web/` with React + Zustand + React Query. Key integration points:
- `apps/web/src/lib/` — crypto, services, stores
- `apps/web/src/hooks/` — React hooks (useFolder, useAuth, etc.)
- `apps/web/src/components/` — React components
- `packages/crypto/` — shared crypto module (@cipherbox/crypto)
- IPNS polling happens in the folder store (Zustand) via `useInterval`
- Folder metadata is decrypted client-side and stored in Zustand
- AES-256-GCM is used for content encryption
- User's vaultKeypair (secp256k1) is in the auth store
- IndexedDB is already used for device registry (via `idb` library)

</planning_context>

# Phase 15.1: Client-Side Search - Context

**Gathered:** 2026-02-24
**Status:** Ready for planning

## Phase Boundary

Users can search file and folder names across their entire vault with an encrypted index persisted in IndexedDB. The search is triggered via a command palette overlay (Cmd/Ctrl+K). The index updates incrementally when IPNS polling detects metadata changes. Shared items are not indexed. Full-text content search is out of scope.

## Implementation Decisions

### Search Interface

- Command palette / spotlight style overlay triggered by Cmd/Ctrl+K keyboard shortcut
- Small clickable search icon in the header as a visual hint (alongside the shortcut)
- Centered modal with search input at top, results streaming below as user types
- Escape key and click-outside both dismiss the overlay
- Backdrop: #000000CC (dimmed app background)

### Result Presentation

- Each result shows: file/folder name (bold), parent path breadcrumb, last modified date (right-aligned, abbreviated)
- File type icons (lucide) distinguish files from folders (file-text, folder, file-lock, file-spreadsheet, etc.)
- Match characters highlighted in the file name
- Keyboard navigable: arrow keys move selection, Enter opens result
- Selected state: green left border accent (2px #00D084) + subtle background highlight (#001a11)
- Click/select navigates to the parent folder with the matched item highlighted
- Footer shows keyboard hints: "↑↓ navigate ↵ open esc close" and "⌘K search"

### Index Scope & Behavior

- Index covers both file names and folder names (not content)
- Fuzzy matching (like VS Code file search — typing 'rpt' matches 'report.pdf')
- Index updates automatically on every IPNS poll (30s interval) when metadata changes detected
- Index encrypted with user's key before persisting to IndexedDB (zero-knowledge on disk)
- Own vault only — shared items ("Shared with me") are not indexed

### Empty & Edge States

- No results: simple message "No results for 'xyz'" — minimal, no suggestions
- First-time indexing: build on first search open with "Building index..." loading state
- Empty input: placeholder text "Search files..." only, no other content
- Empty vault: same "No results" message (no special empty-vault state needed)

### Claude's Discretion

- Exact number of visible results before scroll (somewhere around 8-10)
- Loading skeleton/spinner design during index build
- Debounce timing for search-as-you-type
- IndexedDB schema for encrypted index storage
- minisearch configuration (fields, boost weights, fuzzy threshold)

## Specific Ideas

- Command palette feel like VS Code Cmd+P or Raycast — fast, keyboard-first
- Terminal aesthetic must be preserved: JetBrains Mono, green on black, sharp corners (0 radius)
- Search overlay width: 600px (spacious option chosen), centered horizontally, positioned ~120px from top
- File type icons from lucide icon set (file-text, folder, file-lock, file-spreadsheet, etc.) in muted green (#006644), turning bright (#00D084) on selected row
- Result count shown as terminal comment: "// 5 results"

## Approved Design Direction

**Frame:** Option B: Spacious (ID: rLDDc)
**Canvas location:** `Drafts - Phase 15.1: Search` (right side of canvas at x:30040)

**Key design decisions:**

- 600px wide palette with 1px #00D084 border
- Search input: 14px font, lucide search icon, "ESC to close" hint
- Results: horizontal layout with icon (16px) + info column (name 12px bold, path 10px muted) + date (10px dim, right-aligned)
- Selected state: #001a11 background, 2px left #00D084 border, icon turns bright green
- Footer: keyboard hints in #4a5a4e, separated by top border #003322

## Deferred Ideas

- Recent search history (show 2-3 past queries on overlay open) — nice-to-have for future release
- Searching shared items — would require indexing across share boundaries, separate phase
- Full-text content search — fundamentally different (requires decrypting file contents), out of scope

**Prior Decisions from STATE.md relevant to this phase:**
- minisearch + idb for client-side search (~8KB total, TypeScript-native, zero server interaction) -- research decision

**Codebase Architecture Context:**

The web app is at `apps/web/` with React + Zustand + React Query. Key integration points:
- `apps/web/src/lib/` — crypto, services, stores
- `apps/web/src/hooks/` — React hooks (useFolder, useAuth, etc.)
- `apps/web/src/components/` — React components
- `packages/crypto/` — shared crypto module (@cipherbox/crypto)
- IPNS polling happens in the folder store (Zustand) via `useInterval`
- Folder metadata is decrypted client-side and stored in Zustand
- AES-256-GCM is used for content encryption
- User's vaultKeypair (secp256k1) is in the auth store
- IndexedDB is already used for device registry (via `idb` library)

    92→    Create a standalone TypeScript class `SearchIndexService` in `apps/web/src/services/search-index.service.ts`. This service has NO React dependencies -- it's a pure service class that can be instantiated and used by hooks.
    93→
    94→    **Data model for indexed documents:**
    95→
    96→    ```typescript
    97→    type SearchDocument = {
    98→      id: string;          // unique key: `${folderId}:${childId}` (avoids collisions across folders)
    99→      name: string;        // file or folder name (what users search for)
   100→      type: 'file' | 'folder';
   101→      parentPath: string;  // breadcrumb path like "My Vault / Documents / Reports"
   102→      parentFolderId: string; // folder ID for navigation on result click
   103→      modifiedAt: number;  // timestamp for display in results
   104→    };
   105→    ```
   106→
   107→    **MiniSearch configuration:**
   108→
   109→    ```typescript
   110→    const miniSearch = new MiniSearch<SearchDocument>({
   111→      fields: ['name'],           // only index file/folder names
   112→      storeFields: ['name', 'type', 'parentPath', 'parentFolderId', 'modifiedAt'],
   113→      searchOptions: {
   114→        fuzzy: 0.2,               // fuzzy matching threshold
   115→        prefix: true,             // prefix matching (typing 'rep' matches 'report')
   116→        boost: { name: 1 },      // single field, no boost needed but explicit
   117→      },
   118→    });
   119→    ```
   120→
   121→    **Class API:**
   122→
   123→    ```typescript
   124→    export class SearchIndexService {
   125→      private miniSearch: MiniSearch<SearchDocument>;
   126→      private indexVersion: number = 0;  // increments on each rebuild, used for cache invalidation
   127→
   128→      constructor();
   129→
   130→      /** Build the full index from the folder store's folder tree.
   131→       *  Walks all loaded FolderNodes and indexes their children (files and folders).
   132→       *  @param folders - Record<string, FolderNode> from folder store
   133→       */
   134→      buildFromFolderTree(folders: Record<string, FolderNode>): void;
   135→
   136→      /** Search the index with fuzzy matching.
   137→       *  @param query - user's search string
   138→       *  @returns Array of SearchResult (SearchDocument + score + match info)
   139→       */
   140→      search(query: string): SearchResult[];
   141→
   142→      /** Persist the current index to IndexedDB, encrypted with the provided key.
   143→       *  Derives an AES-256 key from the user's vault private key using HKDF
   144→       *  with info "cipherbox-search-index-v1".
   145→       *  Serializes the MiniSearch index to JSON, encrypts with AES-256-GCM,
   146→       *  stores { iv: number[], data: number[] } in IndexedDB.
   147→       *  @param userPrivateKey - user's secp256k1 private key (32 bytes) for HKDF derivation
   148→       */
   149→      persistEncrypted(userPrivateKey: Uint8Array): Promise<void>;
   150→
   151→      /** Load the index from IndexedDB and decrypt.
   152→       *  @param userPrivateKey - user's secp256k1 private key (32 bytes) for HKDF derivation
   153→       *  @returns true if index was loaded successfully, false if not found or decryption failed
   154→       */
   155→      loadEncrypted(userPrivateKey: Uint8Array): Promise<boolean>;
   156→
   157→      /** Clear the in-memory index and remove from IndexedDB. Call on logout. */
   158→      clear(): Promise<void>;
   159→
   160→      /** Returns whether the index has any documents */
   161→      get isEmpty(): boolean;
   162→
   163→      /** Returns the number of indexed documents */
   164→      get size(): number;
   165→    }
   166→    ```
   167→
   168→    **SearchResult type:**
   169→
   170→    ```typescript
   171→    export type SearchResult = {
   172→      id: string;
   173→      name: string;
   174→      type: 'file' | 'folder';
   175→      parentPath: string;
   176→      parentFolderId: string;
   177→      modifiedAt: number;
   178→      score: number;
   179→      match: Record<string, string[]>;  // from MiniSearch, for highlight info
   180→    };
   181→    ```
   182→
   183→    **buildFromFolderTree implementation details:**
   184→
   185→    1. Clear existing index (`miniSearch.removeAll()`)
   186→    2. Walk all FolderNodes in the `folders` record
   187→    3. For each folder, build the parent path by walking up parentId chain to root
   188→    4. For each child in `folder.children`:
   189→       - Create a SearchDocument with `id: ${folder.id}:${child.id}`, `name: child.name`, `type: child.type`, `parentPath`, `parentFolderId: folder.id`, `modifiedAt: child.modifiedAt ?? child.createdAt ?? 0`
   190→    5. Also index the folders themselves (except root): for each FolderNode, add a document with the folder's own name, its parentId as parentFolderId, and its parent's path
   191→    6. Batch add all documents via `miniSearch.addAll(documents)`
   192→    7. Increment `indexVersion`
   193→
   194→    **Path building helper:**
   195→
   196→    ```typescript
   197→    private buildPath(folderId: string, folders: Record<string, FolderNode>): string {
   198→      const parts: string[] = [];
   199→      let currentId: string | null = folderId;
   200→      while (currentId) {
   201→        const folder = folders[currentId];
   202→        if (!folder) break;
   203→        parts.unshift(folder.name);
   204→        currentId = folder.parentId;
   205→      }
   206→      return parts.join(' / ');
   207→    }
   208→    ```
   209→
   210→    **IndexedDB persistence (follow existing pattern from device/identity.ts):**
   211→
   212→    - DB name: `cipherbox-search`
   213→    - DB version: 1
   214→    - Store name: `index`
   215→    - Key: `encrypted-index`
   216→    - Stored value: `{ iv: number[], data: number[] }` (number arrays for cross-browser IndexedDB compat, same pattern as device identity)
   217→
   218→    **Encryption approach:**
   219→
   220→    Use HKDF to derive a dedicated AES-256 key from the user's vault private key:
   221→    - Import user's 32-byte private key as HKDF base key material
   222→    - Use HKDF with SHA-256, no salt, info: "cipherbox-search-index-v1"
   223→    - Derive 256-bit AES-GCM key
   224→    - Generate random 12-byte IV for each encryption
   225→    - Encrypt the JSON-serialized MiniSearch index
   226→
   227→    Use Web Crypto API directly for HKDF + AES-GCM (not the @cipherbox/crypto encryptAesGcm which expects a raw Uint8Array key). The HKDF derivation ensures the search index key is domain-separated from other keys derived from the same private key.
   228→
   229→    ```typescript
   230→    private async deriveSearchKey(userPrivateKey: Uint8Array): Promise<CryptoKey> {
   231→      const baseKey = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
   232→        'raw', userPrivateKey, 'HKDF', false, ['deriveKey']
   233→      );
   234→      return crypto.subtle.deriveKey(
   235→        { name: 'HKDF', hash: 'SHA-256', salt: new Uint8Array(0), info: new TextEncoder().encode('cipherbox-search-index-v1') },
   236→        baseKey,
   237→        { name: 'AES-GCM', length: 256 },
   238→        false,
   239→        ['encrypt', 'decrypt']
   240→      );
   241→    }
   242→    ```

1→# Phase 15.1: Client-Side Search - Context
     2→
     3→**Gathered:** 2026-02-24
     4→**Status:** Ready for planning
     5→
     6→<domain>
     7→## Phase Boundary
     8→
     9→Users can search file and folder names across their entire vault with an encrypted index persisted in IndexedDB. The search is triggered via a command palette overlay (Cmd/Ctrl+K). The index updates incrementally when IPNS polling detects metadata changes. Shared items are not indexed. Full-text content search is out of scope.
    10→
    11→</domain>
    12→
    13→<decisions>
    14→## Implementation Decisions
    15→
    16→### Search Interface
    17→
    18→- Command palette / spotlight style overlay triggered by Cmd/Ctrl+K keyboard shortcut
    19→- Small clickable search icon in the header as a visual hint (alongside the shortcut)
    20→- Centered modal with search input at top, results streaming below as user types
    21→- Escape key and click-outside both dismiss the overlay
    22→- Backdrop: #000000CC (dimmed app background)
    23→
    24→### Result Presentation
    25→
    26→- Each result shows: file/folder name (bold), parent path breadcrumb, last modified date (right-aligned, abbreviated)
    27→- File type icons (lucide) distinguish files from folders (file-text, folder, file-lock, file-spreadsheet, etc.)
    28→- Match characters highlighted in the file name
    29→- Keyboard navigable: arrow keys move selection, Enter opens result
    30→- Selected result: green left border accent (2px #00D084) + subtle background highlight (#001a11)
    31→- Click/select navigates to the parent folder with the matched item highlighted
    32→- Footer shows keyboard hints: "↑↓ navigate ↵ open esc close" and "⌘K search"
    33→
    34→### Index Scope & Behavior
    35→
    36→- Index covers both file names and folder names (not content)
    37→- Fuzzy matching (like VS Code file search — typing 'rpt' matches 'report.pdf')
    38→- Index updates automatically on every IPNS poll (30s interval) when metadata changes detected
    39→- Index encrypted with user's key before persisting to IndexedDB (zero-knowledge on disk)
    40→- Own vault only — shared items ("Shared with me") are not indexed
    41→
    42→### Empty & Edge States
    43→
    44→- No results: simple message "No results for 'xyz'" — minimal, no suggestions
    45→- First-time indexing: build on first search open with "Building index..." loading state
    46→- Empty input: placeholder text "Search files..." only, no other content
    47→- Empty vault: same "No results" message (no special empty-vault state needed)
    48→
    49→### Claude's Discretion
    50→
    51→- Exact number of visible results before scroll (somewhere around 8-10)
    52→- Loading skeleton/spinner design during index build
    53→- Debounce timing for search-as-you-type
    54→- IndexedDB schema for encrypted index storage
    55→- minisearch configuration (fields, boost weights, fuzzy threshold)
    56→
    57→</decisions>
    58→
    59→<specifics>
    60→## Specific Ideas
    61→
    62→- Command palette feel like VS Code Cmd+P or Raycast — fast, keyboard-first
    63→- Terminal aesthetic must be preserved: JetBrains Mono, green on black, sharp corners (0 radius)
    64→- Search overlay width: 600px (spacious option chosen), centered horizontally, positioned ~120px from top
    65→- File type icons from lucide icon set (file-text, folder, file-lock, file-spreadsheet, etc.) in muted green (#006644), turning bright (#00D084) on selected row
    66→- Result count shown as terminal comment: "// 5 results"
    67→
    68→</specifics>
    69→
    70→<design>
    71→## Approved Design Direction
    72→
    73→**Frame:** Option B: Spacious (ID: rLDDc)
    74→**Canvas location:** `Drafts - Phase 15.1: Search` (right side of canvas at x:30040)
    75→
    76→**Key design decisions:**
    77→
    78→- 600px wide palette with 1px #00D084 border
    79→- Search input: 14px font, lucide search icon, "ESC to close" hint
    80→- Results: horizontal layout with icon (16px) + info column (name 12px bold, path 10px muted) + date (10px dim, right-aligned)
    81→- Selected state: #001a11 background, 2px left #00D084 border, icon turns bright green
    82→- Footer: keyboard hints in #4a5a4e, separated by top border #003322
    83→
    84→</design>
    85→
    86→<deferred>
    87→## Deferred Ideas
    88→
    89→- Recent search history (show 2-3 past queries on overlay open) — nice-to-have for future release
    90→- Searching shared items — would require indexing across share boundaries, separate phase
    91→- Full-text content search — fundamentally different (requires decrypting file contents), out of scope
    92→
    93→</deferred>

The current `handleSync` in `/Users/michael/Code/cipher-box/apps/web/src/components/file-browser/FileBrowser.tsx` (line 253-299) only resolves the root folder's IPNS record and updates root folder children. The `triggerSearchIndexRebuild` call planned for after this sync handler will rebuild the index from `useFolderStore.getState().folders`, which contains all loaded folders (not just root). This means the search index will contain all folders that have been navigated to and loaded into the store. New subfolders added on another device would only appear in the search index after the user navigates to the parent folder (which triggers subfolder metadata fetch). This is an inherent limitation of the current sync architecture, not a plan deficiency -- the plan correctly indexes everything in the store.
